```{r}

# -------------------------------
# 0) Load data
# -------------------------------
# NCSS pedon-level pack (already built)
# must contain: peiid + taxorder + your pedon predictors
ncss <- pedon_pack_150_p %>% 
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

# Perry horizon-level table (you already have this)
# perry_fp <- read_csv("../data/Perry_FP_data_with_taxa_02_20_2026.csv")
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# -------------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------------
parse_top_bottom <- function(x) {
  top <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "^\\d+"))
  bot <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?<=-)\\d+"))
  tibble(top_cm = top, bottom_cm = bot)
}

hz_base <- function(hz) {
  h <- str_to_upper(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  h <- str_replace_all(h, "\\s+", "")
  h <- str_remove(h, "\\d+$")
  case_when(
    str_detect(h, "^AP") ~ "Ap",
    str_detect(h, "^A")  ~ "A",
    str_detect(h, "^E")  ~ "E",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T].*G") ~ "Btg",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T]")    ~ "Bt",
    str_detect(h, "^B[X]")    ~ "Bx",
    str_detect(h, "^BC")      ~ "BC",
    str_detect(h, "^B")       ~ "B",
    str_detect(h, "^C")       ~ "C",
    str_detect(h, "^R")       ~ "R",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

is_carbonate_hz <- function(hz) {
  h <- str_to_lower(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  str_detect(h, "k")
}

is_gleyed <- function(hz, chroma) {
  h <- str_to_lower(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  g_suffix <- str_detect(h, "g")
  low_chroma <- !is.na(chroma) & chroma <= 2
  g_suffix | low_chroma
}

hex_to_rgb01 <- function(hex_vec) {
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(hex_vec), ncol = 3)
  ok <- !is.na(hex_vec) & nzchar(hex_vec)
  if (any(ok)) {
    rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex_vec[ok])
    out[ok, ] <- t(rgb) / 255
  }
  out
}

add_top1_margin <- function(pred_df) {
  pred_cols <- names(pred_df)[str_detect(names(pred_df), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_df) != ".pred_class"]
  pred_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      top1 = max(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
      top2 = sort(c_across(all_of(pred_cols)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
      margin = top1 - top2
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# -------------------------------
# Build Perry pedon pack 0–150
# -------------------------------
build_perry_pedon_pack_0_150 <- function(perry_fp) {

  hz <- perry_fp %>%
    mutate(
      Point = as.character(Point),
      Horizon = as.character(Horizon),
      To.Depth..cm. = as.character(To.Depth..cm.)
    ) %>%
    bind_cols(parse_top_bottom(.$To.Depth..cm.)) %>%
    mutate(
      bottom_cm = if_else(is.na(bottom_cm) & !is.na(top_cm) & !is.na(H.Depth.cm.),
                          top_cm + as.numeric(H.Depth.cm.),
                          bottom_cm),
      top_cm = as.numeric(top_cm),
      bottom_cm = as.numeric(bottom_cm)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(top_cm), is.finite(bottom_cm), bottom_cm > top_cm) %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    tidyr::fill(Horizon, .direction = "down") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      top150 = pmax(top_cm, 0),
      bot150 = pmin(bottom_cm, 150),
      thk150 = pmax(0, bot150 - top150)
    ) %>%
    filter(thk150 > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      hzbase = hz_base(Horizon),
      sand = as.numeric(lab_sand),
      silt = as.numeric(lab_silt),
      clay = as.numeric(lab_clay)
    )

  # robust Munsell parse
  m_raw <- aqp::parseMunsell(hz$Matrix.Color)
  m <- as.data.frame(m_raw)
  for (nm in c("hue","value","chroma","hex")) if (!nm %in% names(m)) m[[nm]] <- NA
  rgb01 <- hex_to_rgb01(m$hex)

  hz <- hz %>%
    mutate(
      chroma = m$chroma,
      hex    = m$hex,
      R      = rgb01[, 1],
      G      = rgb01[, 2],
      B      = rgb01[, 3],
      gley_flag = is_gleyed(Horizon, chroma),
      carb_flag = is_carbonate_hz(Horizon),
      fragipan_flag = str_detect(str_to_lower(Horizon %||% ""), "bx|btx")
    )

  bt_set <- c("Bt","Btg","Btc","Btcb","Btx","Btb","Btv","Btvx","Btcn","Btgb","Btgx","Btgv","Btss","Btvc","Btcv")
  e_set  <- c("E","Eg","EB","BE","Ec","Eb","Ex")

  pedon <- hz %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    summarise(
      peiid = Point,

      sand_w = weighted.mean(sand, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),
      silt_w = weighted.mean(silt, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),
      clay_w = weighted.mean(clay, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),

      R_w = weighted.mean(R, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),
      G_w = weighted.mean(G, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),
      B_w = weighted.mean(B, w = thk150, na.rm = TRUE),

      has_Bt_0_150 = any(hzbase %in% bt_set, na.rm = TRUE),
      has_E_0_150  = any(hzbase %in% e_set,  na.rm = TRUE),
      has_gley_0_150 = any(gley_flag, na.rm = TRUE),

      depth_to_Bt_cm = if_else(has_Bt_0_150, min(top150[hzbase %in% bt_set], na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      depth_to_E_cm  = if_else(has_E_0_150,  min(top150[hzbase %in% e_set],  na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      depth_to_gley_cm = if_else(has_gley_0_150, min(top150[gley_flag], na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),

      bt_thk_0_150_cm = sum(thk150[hzbase %in% bt_set], na.rm = TRUE),

      # horizon-only argillic proxies
      has_argillic_0_150    = has_Bt_0_150,
      depth_to_argillic_cm  = if_else(has_Bt_0_150, depth_to_Bt_cm, NA_real_),
      argillic_thk_0_150_cm = bt_thk_0_150_cm,

      any_argillic  = has_Bt_0_150,
      any_gleyed    = has_gley_0_150,
      any_fragipan  = any(fragipan_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_carbonate = any(carb_flag, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # broad prop_hzbase_* set (we will also pad missing ones later)
  hz_levels <- c(
    "A","Ap","Ab","Ag","E","Eg","Ex","B","Bc","Bh","Bt","Btg","Btgx","Btss","BC",
    "C","Cg","Oa","Oe","R","Unknown"
  )

  prop <- hz %>%
    mutate(hzbase = factor(hzbase, levels = hz_levels)) %>%
    group_by(Point, hzbase) %>%
    summarise(thk = sum(thk150, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    mutate(prop = thk / sum(thk, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Point, hzbase, prop) %>%
    complete(Point, hzbase, fill = list(prop = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = hzbase, values_from = prop, names_prefix = "prop_hzbase_")

  pedon %>% left_join(prop, by = c("peiid" = "Point"))
}
# Build Perry pedon-level pack (0-150) using YOUR existing function
# (Assumes build_perry_pedon_pack_0_150() is defined earlier in your file)
perry_pack_150 <- build_perry_pedon_pack_0_150(perry_fp) %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  distinct(peiid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# -------------------------------
# 1) Make NCSS order dataset (handle rare classes)
# -------------------------------
set.seed(101)

min_n_order <- 15

ncss_order <- ncss %>%
  mutate(
    taxorder = factor(taxorder),
    taxorder = fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = min_n_order, other_level = "Other")
  ) %>%
  filter(taxorder != "Other") %>%
  droplevels()

# critical: remove integer-vs-double headaches up front
ncss_order <- ncss_order %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

split <- initial_split(ncss_order, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)

# -------------------------------
# 2) Recipe (NO TAXA LEAKAGE) + robust numeric bake
# -------------------------------
rec <- recipe(taxorder ~ ., data = train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxsubgrp", "taxpartsize"
  ))) %>%
  # Safety: if any characters remain as predictors, convert to factors
  step_mutate_at(all_nominal_predictors(), fn = as.factor) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec <- prep(rec)

# Bake
b_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train)
b_test  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test)

# Remove outcome + id if they survived
x_train <- b_train %>% select(-any_of(c("taxorder", "peiid")))
x_test  <- b_test  %>% select(-any_of(c("taxorder", "peiid")))

# Convert logical -> numeric
x_train <- x_train %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))
x_test  <- x_test  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

# HARD GUARANTEE: keep only numeric columns for UMAP
bad_train <- names(x_train)[!vapply(x_train, is.numeric, logical(1))]
bad_test  <- names(x_test)[!vapply(x_test,  is.numeric, logical(1))]

if (length(bad_train) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_train: ", paste(bad_train, collapse = ", "))
  x_train <- x_train %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}
if (length(bad_test) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_test: ", paste(bad_test, collapse = ", "))
  x_test <- x_test %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train, is.numeric, logical(1))))
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_test,  is.numeric, logical(1))))

# -------------------------------
# 3) Fit UMAP on NCSS baked predictors
# -------------------------------
set.seed(202)

k_umap <- 10

umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
  X = as.matrix(x_train),
  n_components = k_umap,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
names(z_train) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train)))

z_test <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test), umap_fit))
names(z_test) <- names(z_train)

train_umap <- bind_cols(z_train, taxorder = train$taxorder)
test_umap  <- bind_cols(z_test,  taxorder = test$taxorder)

# -------------------------------
# 4) Fit RF on UMAP embeddings (optionally tune)
# -------------------------------
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_umap_rf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(taxorder ~ .)

rf_fit <- fit(wf_umap_rf, data = train_umap)

# Evaluate on held-out NCSS test
pred_test <- predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap %>% select(taxorder))

conf_mat(pred_test, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)
metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred_test, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)

# -------------------------------
# 5) Pad Perry to match RAW columns expected by the recipe
#    (so bake() won’t fail)
# -------------------------------
pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl) || is.numeric(tmpl)) {
      # numeric columns: default NA_real_ (recipe imputes)
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      # character/factor columns: NA_character_
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }

    # special case: horizon proportions absent in Perry should be 0, not NA
    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) out[[nm]] <- 0
    if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)"))  out[[nm]] <- FALSE
  }

  # Ensure same basic numeric type choices: no integers
  out <- out %>% mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

  # Keep required raw columns (plus peiid)
  out %>% select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

# add placeholders for taxonomy fields that recipe saw (even if removed)
perry_raw <- perry_pack_150 %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname_clean = NA_character_,
    taxsuborder     = NA_character_,
    taxgrtgroup     = NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp       = NA_character_,
    taxpartsize     = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

perry_ready_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(perry_raw, train, outcome = "taxorder")

# sanity: what raw cols are still missing?
setdiff(setdiff(names(train), "taxorder"), names(perry_ready_raw))

# -------------------------------
# 6) Bake Perry with SAME recipe, UMAP-transform, RF predict order
# -------------------------------
x_perry <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = perry_ready_raw)

# drop id/outcome if present
x_perry <- x_perry %>% select(-any_of(c("taxorder","peiid")))

# logical -> double
x_perry <- x_perry %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

# drop any leftover non-numeric columns (and show them)
bad_perry <- names(x_perry)[!vapply(x_perry, is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(bad_perry) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_perry: ", paste(bad_perry, collapse = ", "))
  x_perry <- x_perry %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_perry, is.numeric, logical(1))))
# -------------------------------
# 7) UMAP-transform Perry (same umap_fit) and RF predict ORDER
# -------------------------------

# Transform Perry into the SAME UMAP space as NCSS training
z_perry <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_perry), umap_fit))
names(z_perry) <- names(z_train)  # U1..U10

perry_umap <- bind_cols(
  perry_ready_raw %>% select(peiid),
  z_perry
)

# Predict order probabilities + class
perry_pred <- bind_cols(
  perry_umap %>% select(peiid),
  predict(rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "prob"),
  predict(rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "class")
)

# Add confidence metrics (top1 + margin)
pred_cols <- names(perry_pred)[
  str_detect(names(perry_pred), "^\\.pred_") & names(perry_pred) != ".pred_class"
]

perry_pred <- perry_pred %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    top1 = max(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
    top2 = sort(c_across(all_of(pred_cols)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top1 - top2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Quick look
perry_pred %>%
  select(peiid, .pred_class, top1, margin) %>%
  arrange(desc(top1)) %>%
  print(n = 50)

# Distribution of predicted orders
perry_pred %>%
  count(.pred_class, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build pedon-level truth taxorder from perry_fp
#    (perry_fp is horizon-level, so we collapse to Point)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
perry_truth_order <- perry_fp %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(Point),
    taxorder = na_if(str_trim(as.character(taxorder)), "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  summarise(
    # take the most common non-NA taxorder within a pedon
    taxorder_truth = {
      x <- taxorder[!is.na(taxorder)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    n_hz = n(),
    n_tax_nonNA = sum(!is.na(taxorder)),
    n_tax_unique = n_distinct(taxorder[!is.na(taxorder)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# sanity: how many pedons actually have truth?
perry_truth_order %>%
  summarise(
    pedons_total = n(),
    pedons_with_truth = sum(!is.na(taxorder_truth)),
    pedons_missing_truth = sum(is.na(taxorder_truth)),
    pedons_conflicting_truth = sum(!is.na(taxorder_truth) & n_tax_unique > 1)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Join predictions to truth
# ------------------------------------------------------------
perry_val <- perry_pred %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  left_join(perry_truth_order, by = "peiid") %>%
  mutate(
    taxorder_truth = factor(taxorder_truth),
    .pred_class = factor(.pred_class)
  )

# show which pedons are missing truth or conflicting
perry_val %>%
  filter(is.na(taxorder_truth) | n_tax_unique > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tax_unique), peiid) %>%
  select(peiid, taxorder_truth, n_hz, n_tax_nonNA, n_tax_unique, .pred_class, top1, margin) %>%
  print(n = 200)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Evaluate ONLY where truth exists and is not conflicting
# ------------------------------------------------------------
perry_eval <- perry_val %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxorder_truth), n_tax_unique == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    # align levels so yardstick doesn't drop stuff unexpectedly
    taxorder_truth = fct_drop(taxorder_truth),
    .pred_class    = fct_drop(.pred_class)
  )

cat("Pedons used for validation:", nrow(perry_eval), "\n")

# counts
cat("\n=== TRUTH COUNTS (Perry) ===\n")
print(count(perry_eval, taxorder_truth, sort = TRUE))

cat("\n=== PRED COUNTS (Perry) ===\n")
print(count(perry_eval, .pred_class, sort = TRUE))

# confusion matrix
cat("\n=== CONFUSION MATRIX (Perry) ===\n")
print(conf_mat(perry_eval, truth = taxorder_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

# metrics
cat("\n=== METRICS (Perry) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(perry_eval, truth = taxorder_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

# optional: accuracy for high-confidence subset
cat("\n=== METRICS (top1 >= 0.8) ===\n")
print(
  perry_eval %>%
    filter(top1 >= 0.8) %>%
    metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(truth = taxorder_truth, estimate = .pred_class)
)
```


```{r}
#great  group:
# ============================================================
# 0) Build/ensure pedon-level tables exist
# ============================================================
ncss <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

perry_pack_150 <- build_perry_pedon_pack_0_150(perry_fp) %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  distinct(peiid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 1) NCSS GREAT GROUP dataset (lump rare groups)
# ============================================================
set.seed(301)

min_n_gg <- 8  # adjust if needed; 8–15 is typical
ncss_gg <- ncss %>%
  mutate(
    taxgrtgroup = factor(taxgrtgroup),
    taxgrtgroup = fct_lump_min(taxgrtgroup, min = min_n_gg, other_level = "Other")
  ) %>%
  filter(taxgrtgroup != "Other") %>%
  droplevels()

# avoid integer/double mismatches
ncss_gg <- ncss_gg %>% mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

split_gg <- initial_split(ncss_gg, prop = 0.8, strata = taxgrtgroup)
train_gg <- training(split_gg)
test_gg  <- testing(split_gg)

# ============================================================
# 2) Recipe (NO TAXA LEAKAGE) for GREAT GROUP
# ============================================================
rec_gg <- recipe(taxgrtgroup ~ ., data = train_gg) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxsubgrp", "taxpartsize"
  ))) %>%
  step_mutate_at(all_nominal_predictors(), fn = as.factor) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_gg <- prep(rec_gg)

b_train_gg <- bake(prep_gg, new_data = train_gg)
b_test_gg  <- bake(prep_gg, new_data = test_gg)

x_train_gg <- b_train_gg %>% select(-any_of(c("taxgrtgroup", "peiid")))
x_test_gg  <- b_test_gg  %>% select(-any_of(c("taxgrtgroup", "peiid")))

x_train_gg <- x_train_gg %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))
x_test_gg  <- x_test_gg  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

# drop any non-numeric baked columns (UMAP needs numeric)
bad_train <- names(x_train_gg)[!vapply(x_train_gg, is.numeric, logical(1))]
bad_test  <- names(x_test_gg )[!vapply(x_test_gg,  is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(bad_train) > 0) x_train_gg <- x_train_gg %>% select(where(is.numeric))
if (length(bad_test)  > 0) x_test_gg  <- x_test_gg  %>% select(where(is.numeric))

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train_gg, is.numeric, logical(1))))
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_test_gg,  is.numeric, logical(1))))

# ============================================================
# 3) UMAP on baked predictors (NCSS)
# ============================================================
set.seed(302)
k_umap_gg <- 10

umap_gg <- uwot::umap(
  X = as.matrix(x_train_gg),
  n_components = k_umap_gg,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train_gg <- as.data.frame(umap_gg$embedding)
names(z_train_gg) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_gg)))

z_test_gg <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_gg), umap_gg))
names(z_test_gg) <- names(z_train_gg)

train_umap_gg <- bind_cols(z_train_gg, taxgrtgroup = train_gg$taxgrtgroup)
test_umap_gg  <- bind_cols(z_test_gg,  taxgrtgroup = test_gg$taxgrtgroup)

# ============================================================
# 4) RF on UMAP embeddings (GREAT GROUP)
# ============================================================
rf_spec_gg <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_gg <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_gg) %>%
  add_formula(taxgrtgroup ~ .)

rf_fit_gg <- fit(wf_gg, data = train_umap_gg)

# quick NCSS test evaluation
pred_test_gg <- bind_cols(
  predict(rf_fit_gg, test_umap_gg, type = "prob"),
  predict(rf_fit_gg, test_umap_gg, type = "class"),
  test_umap_gg %>% select(taxgrtgroup)
)

pred_test_gg <- pred_test_gg %>%
  mutate(.pred_class = factor(.pred_class, levels = levels(taxgrtgroup)))

cat("\n=== NCSS GREAT GROUP CONFUSION (test) ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred_test_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== NCSS GREAT GROUP METRICS (test) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred_test_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup, estimate = .pred_class))

# ============================================================
# 5) Pad Perry raw to match bake() requirements (same as before)
# ============================================================
pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))
  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]
    if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl) || is.numeric(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) out[[nm]] <- 0
    if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)"))  out[[nm]] <- FALSE
  }

  out %>% mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

perry_raw_gg <- perry_pack_150 %>%
  mutate(
    # placeholders for taxonomy text cols that recipe may have seen
    taxonname_clean = NA_character_,
    taxorder     = NA_character_,
    taxsuborder  = NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp    = NA_character_,
    taxpartsize  = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

perry_ready_gg <- pad_like_train_raw(perry_raw_gg, train_gg, outcome = "taxgrtgroup")

# ============================================================
# 6) Bake Perry → UMAP transform → Predict GREAT GROUP
# ============================================================
x_perry_gg <- bake(prep_gg, new_data = perry_ready_gg) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("taxgrtgroup","peiid"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

bad_perry <- names(x_perry_gg)[!vapply(x_perry_gg, is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(bad_perry) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_perry_gg: ", paste(bad_perry, collapse = ", "))
  x_perry_gg <- x_perry_gg %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_perry_gg, is.numeric, logical(1))))

z_perry_gg <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_perry_gg), umap_gg))
names(z_perry_gg) <- names(z_train_gg)

perry_umap_gg <- bind_cols(perry_ready_gg %>% select(peiid), z_perry_gg)

perry_pred_gg <- bind_cols(
  perry_umap_gg %>% select(peiid),
  predict(rf_fit_gg, perry_umap_gg, type = "prob"),
  predict(rf_fit_gg, perry_umap_gg, type = "class")
)

# confidence (top1 + margin)
pred_cols_gg <- names(perry_pred_gg)[
  str_detect(names(perry_pred_gg), "^\\.pred_") & names(perry_pred_gg) != ".pred_class"
]

perry_pred_gg <- perry_pred_gg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    top1 = max(c_across(all_of(pred_cols_gg))),
    top2 = sort(c_across(all_of(pred_cols_gg)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top1 - top2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== PERRY GREAT GROUP PRED COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(perry_pred_gg, .pred_class, sort = TRUE))

perry_pred_gg %>%
  select(peiid, .pred_class, top1, margin) %>%
  arrange(desc(top1)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7) External validation on Perry (taxgrtgroup) where truth exists
#    - uses perry_fp horizon table as "truth"
#    - keeps only pedons with a single unique GG label
#    - fixes yardstick "levels must be equivalent" error
# ============================================================

# 7a) Build pedon-level truth from Perry horizons
perry_truth_gg <- perry_fp %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(Point),
    taxgrtgroup = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxgrtgroup)), "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_hz = n(),
    n_tax_nonNA = sum(!is.na(taxgrtgroup)),
    n_tax_unique = n_distinct(taxgrtgroup[!is.na(taxgrtgroup)]),
    taxgrtgroup_truth = {
      x <- taxgrtgroup[!is.na(taxgrtgroup)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_
      else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 7b) Join truth to predictions and keep "clean truth" pedons only
perry_val_gg <- perry_pred_gg %>%
  left_join(perry_truth_gg, by = "peiid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxgrtgroup_truth), n_tax_unique == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    taxgrtgroup_truth = factor(taxgrtgroup_truth),
    # IMPORTANT: force estimate to have same levels as truth
    .pred_class = factor(as.character(.pred_class), levels = levels(taxgrtgroup_truth))
  )

# 7c) Quick checks
cat("Pedons total predicted:", nrow(perry_pred_gg), "\n")
cat("Pedons with truth:", sum(!is.na(perry_truth_gg$taxgrtgroup_truth)), "\n")
cat("Pedons used for GG validation:", nrow(perry_val_gg), "\n")

cat("\n=== TRUTH COUNTS (Perry GG) ===\n")
print(count(perry_val_gg, taxgrtgroup_truth, sort = TRUE))

cat("\n=== PRED COUNTS (Perry GG) ===\n")
print(count(perry_val_gg, .pred_class, sort = TRUE))

# 7d) Confusion + metrics
cat("\n=== CONFUSION MATRIX (Perry GG) ===\n")
print(conf_mat(perry_val_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== METRICS (Perry GG) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(perry_val_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

# Optional: show worst-confidence predictions (useful for debugging)
cat("\n=== LOW CONFIDENCE CASES (Perry GG, top1<0.6 or margin<0.2) ===\n")
perry_val_gg %>%
  mutate(low_conf = top1 < 0.6 | margin < 0.2) %>%
  filter(low_conf) %>%
  arrange(top1) %>%
  select(peiid, taxgrtgroup_truth, .pred_class, top1, margin, n_tax_nonNA, n_hz) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
#subgroup modeling

# ============================================================
# 0) NCSS pedon-level data
# ============================================================
ncss <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

# ============================================================
# 1) Choose subgroup modeling scope
#    A) ALL ORDERS  (many classes -> tougher)
#    B) ONE ORDER   (recommended; fewer classes)
# ============================================================

MODE <- "ONE_ORDER"   # "ALL_ORDERS" or "ONE_ORDER"
ORDER_NAME <- "Ultisols"  # used only if MODE == "ONE_ORDER"

min_n_subgrp <- 10  # raise to 15 if you keep getting rare-level issues

if (MODE == "ALL_ORDERS") {
  df_subgrp <- ncss %>%
    mutate(
      taxsubgrp = factor(taxsubgrp),
      taxsubgrp = fct_lump_min(taxsubgrp, min = min_n_subgrp, other_level = "Other")
    ) %>%
    filter(taxsubgrp != "Other") %>%
    droplevels()
} else {
  df_subgrp <- ncss %>%
    filter(taxorder == ORDER_NAME) %>%
    mutate(
      taxsubgrp = factor(taxsubgrp),
      taxsubgrp = fct_lump_min(taxsubgrp, min = min_n_subgrp, other_level = "Other")
    ) %>%
    filter(taxsubgrp != "Other") %>%
    droplevels()
}

cat("\n=== SUBGROUP COUNTS ===\n")
sub_counts <- count(df_subgrp, taxsubgrp, sort = TRUE)
print(as.data.frame(sub_counts), row.names = FALSE)
# ============================================================
# 2) Split (stratify by subgroup)
# ============================================================
set.seed(1001)
split <- initial_split(df_subgrp, prop = 0.8, strata = taxsubgrp)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)

# ============================================================
# 3) Recipe (NO TAXA LEAKAGE)
#    - remove all taxonomy columns except the outcome we’re predicting
# ============================================================
rec <- recipe(taxsubgrp ~ ., data = train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxpartsize",  # <-- remove taxa predictors
    "taxsubgrp"  # (recipe will keep outcome version; this protects if duplicated)
  ))) %>%
  step_mutate_at(all_nominal_predictors(), fn = as.factor) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec <- prep(rec)

b_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train)
b_test  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test)

x_train <- b_train %>% select(-any_of(c("taxsubgrp", "peiid")))
x_test  <- b_test  %>% select(-any_of(c("taxsubgrp", "peiid")))

# Make UMAP-safe (numeric only)
x_train <- x_train %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))
x_test  <- x_test  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

bad_train <- names(x_train)[!vapply(x_train, is.numeric, logical(1))]
bad_test  <- names(x_test)[!vapply(x_test,  is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(bad_train) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_train: ", paste(bad_train, collapse = ", "))
  x_train <- x_train %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}
if (length(bad_test) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_test: ", paste(bad_test, collapse = ", "))
  x_test <- x_test %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train, is.numeric, logical(1))))
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_test,  is.numeric, logical(1))))

# ============================================================
# 4) UMAP fit on train, transform test
# ============================================================
set.seed(1002)
k_umap <- 10

umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
  X = as.matrix(x_train),
  n_components = k_umap,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
names(z_train) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train)))

z_test <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test), umap_fit))
names(z_test) <- names(z_train)

train_umap <- bind_cols(z_train, taxsubgrp = train$taxsubgrp)
test_umap  <- bind_cols(z_test,  taxsubgrp = test$taxsubgrp)

# ============================================================
# 5) RF fit + evaluation
# ============================================================
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(taxsubgrp ~ .)

rf_fit <- fit(wf, data = train_umap)

pred_class <- predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap %>% select(taxsubgrp))
beepr::beep("wilhelm")
cat("\n=== SUBGROUP CONFUSION MATRIX (NCSS test) ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred_class, truth = taxsubgrp, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== SUBGROUP METRICS (NCSS test) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred_class, truth = taxsubgrp, estimate = .pred_class))

# Optional F1 (macro) — can warn if a class has zero predicted events
cat("\n=== SUBGROUP F1 (macro) ===\n")
print(f_meas(pred_class, truth = taxsubgrp, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

# ============================================================
# 6) (Optional) Add confidence summaries (top1 + margin)
# ============================================================
pred_prob <- predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "prob")
pred_full <- bind_cols(pred_prob, predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type="class"), test_umap %>% select(taxsubgrp))

prob_cols <- names(pred_full)[str_detect(names(pred_full), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_full) != ".pred_class"]

pred_conf <- pred_full %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    top1 = max(c_across(all_of(prob_cols))),
    top2 = sort(c_across(all_of(prob_cols)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top1 - top2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    mean_top1 = mean(top1),
    pct_low_top1 = mean(top1 < 0.6),
    mean_margin = mean(margin),
    pct_low_margin = mean(margin < 0.2)
  )

cat("\n=== SUBGROUP CONFIDENCE SUMMARY (NCSS test) ===\n")
print(pred_conf)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7) Perry truth (pedon-level) for subgroup
# ============================================================

perry_truth_sub <- perry_fp %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(Point),
    taxsubgrp = na_if(taxsubgrp, ""),
    taxorder  = na_if(taxorder, "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_hz = n(),
    n_tax_nonNA = sum(!is.na(taxsubgrp)),
    n_tax_unique = n_distinct(taxsubgrp[!is.na(taxsubgrp)]),
    taxorder_truth = {
      x <- taxorder[!is.na(taxorder)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    taxsubgrp_truth = {
      x <- taxsubgrp[!is.na(taxsubgrp)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Optional: if you are modeling within ONE ORDER, filter Perry truth to that order
if (MODE == "ONE_ORDER") {
  perry_truth_sub <- perry_truth_sub %>% filter(taxorder_truth == ORDER_NAME)
}

# Join Perry truth onto your pedon-level Perry predictors
perry_sub_base <- perry_pack_150 %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  distinct(peiid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(perry_truth_sub, by = "peiid")

# ============================================================
# 8) Pad Perry raw columns to match what the recipe expects
# ============================================================

pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl) || is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

# Add placeholder taxa cols (some recipes blow up if these exist in training but not new_data)
perry_sub_raw <- perry_sub_base %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname_clean = NA_character_,
    taxorder     = NA_character_,
    taxsuborder  = NA_character_,
    taxgrtgroup  = NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp    = NA_character_,
    taxpartsize  = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

perry_sub_ready_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(perry_sub_raw, train, outcome = "taxsubgrp")

# ============================================================
# Bake Perry using same recipe
# ============================================================
x_perry <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = perry_sub_ready_raw) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("taxsubgrp","peiid"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double))

bad_perry <- names(x_perry)[!vapply(x_perry, is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(bad_perry) > 0) {
  message("Dropping non-numeric baked columns in x_perry: ", paste(bad_perry, collapse = ", "))
  x_perry <- x_perry %>% select(where(is.numeric))
}
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_perry, is.numeric, logical(1))))

# ============================================================
# UMAP-transform Perry + predict subgroup
# ============================================================
z_perry <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_perry), umap_fit))
names(z_perry) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_perry)))

perry_umap <- bind_cols(z_perry, peiid = perry_sub_ready_raw$peiid)

perry_pred_prob <- predict(rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "prob")
perry_pred_cls  <- predict(rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "class")

perry_pred_sub <- bind_cols(
  perry_umap %>% select(peiid),
  perry_pred_prob,
  perry_pred_cls
)

# Add top1 + margin
prob_cols <- names(perry_pred_sub)[str_detect(names(perry_pred_sub), "^\\.pred_") & names(perry_pred_sub) != ".pred_class"]
perry_pred_sub <- perry_pred_sub %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    top1 = max(c_across(all_of(prob_cols))),
    top2 = sort(c_across(all_of(prob_cols)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top1 - top2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# ============================================================
# 9) Validation dataset + metrics
# ============================================================

perry_sub_val <- perry_sub_base %>%
  select(peiid, taxsubgrp_truth, n_hz, n_tax_nonNA, n_tax_unique) %>%
  left_join(perry_pred_sub %>% select(peiid, .pred_class, top1, margin), by = "peiid") %>%
  mutate(taxsubgrp_truth = factor(taxsubgrp_truth))

cat("\nPedons total predicted:", nrow(perry_sub_val), "\n")
cat("Pedons with truth:", sum(!is.na(perry_sub_val$taxsubgrp_truth)), "\n")

# Keep only rows with truth for metrics
perry_sub_val2 <- perry_sub_val %>% filter(!is.na(taxsubgrp_truth), !is.na(.pred_class))

# Fix yardstick level mismatch issue
lvl <- union(levels(perry_sub_val2$taxsubgrp_truth), levels(perry_sub_val2$.pred_class))
perry_sub_val2 <- perry_sub_val2 %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp_truth = factor(taxsubgrp_truth, levels = lvl),
    .pred_class     = factor(.pred_class, levels = lvl)
  )

cat("\n=== TRUTH COUNTS (Perry SUBGROUP) ===\n")
print(count(perry_sub_val2, taxsubgrp_truth, sort = TRUE), n = Inf)

cat("\n=== PRED COUNTS (Perry SUBGROUP) ===\n")
print(count(perry_sub_val2, .pred_class, sort = TRUE), n = Inf)

cat("\n=== CONFUSION MATRIX (Perry SUBGROUP) ===\n")
print(conf_mat(perry_sub_val2, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== METRICS (Perry SUBGROUP) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(perry_sub_val2, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== F1 (macro) (Perry SUBGROUP) ===\n")
print(f_meas(perry_sub_val2, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

cat("\n=== LOW CONFIDENCE CASES (Perry SUBGROUP, top1<0.6 or margin<0.2) ===\n")
print(
  perry_sub_val2 %>%
    filter(top1 < 0.6 | margin < 0.2) %>%
    arrange(top1) %>%
    select(peiid, taxsubgrp_truth, .pred_class, top1, margin, n_tax_nonNA, n_hz) %>%
    print(n = 200)
)
```

```{r}
# Subgroups like Rhodic vs Typic are often driven by subtler features (color/redness, mineralogy, etc.) and your current predictor set (weighted sand/silt/clay + RGB + horizon proportions + a few boolean proxies) may not separate them robustly across datasets.

# 1) Map the two Perry-only truths to something the model can represent (optional)
# If you want, map both to "Typic Paleudults" or drop them. Dropping is cleaner.
perry_sub_eval <- perry_sub_val2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxsubgrp_truth)) %>%
  filter(!(taxsubgrp_truth %in% c("Arenic Paleudults", "Oxyaquic Paleudults")))

# 2) Restrict BOTH truth + estimate to ONLY levels present in this eval set

             levels(droplevels(perry_sub_eval$.pred_class)))

perry_sub_eval <- perry_sub_eval %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp_truth = factor(taxsubgrp_truth, levels = lvl),
    .pred_class     = factor(.pred_class,     levels = lvl)
  )

cat("Pedons used:", nrow(perry_sub_eval), "\n")

# 3) Confusion + metrics (no more level errors / NA from empty classes)

print(metric_set(accuracy, kap)(perry_sub_eval, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class))

# For balanced accuracy, compute only on labels that actually occur in truth
# (otherwise yardstick tries to average undefined recalls)
labels_in_truth <- levels(droplevels(perry_sub_eval$taxsubgrp_truth))
perry_sub_eval2 <- perry_sub_eval %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp_truth = factor(taxsubgrp_truth, levels = labels_in_truth),
    .pred_class     = factor(.pred_class,     levels = labels_in_truth)
  )

print(bal_accuracy(perry_sub_eval2, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))
print(f_meas(perry_sub_eval2, truth = taxsubgrp_truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

  group_by(taxsubgrp_truth) %>%
  mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
```
